title: phanera khasiana subsp. polystachya
intro: Phanera khasiana subsp. polystachya, commonly known as Himalayan rattan, is a climbing plant species belonging to the family Moraceae. This plant has been traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine, offering various health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which help in treating wounds, reducing fever, and alleviating respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Phanera khasiana subsp. polystachya include its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit antioxidant properties, and act as an anti-diarrheal agent. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
